name: How should I prepare my home before single room renovation work begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before single room renovation work begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation involves clearing all personal belongings, defining your material selections, and establishing clear household access. Remove all furniture, wall decor, and fragile items from the room, and clear a direct walkway through hallways and entryways for workers carrying tools and materials. Gather design ideas and confirm your preferences for paint sheens, trim styles, and tile patterns before the project begins so work is not paused waiting for decisions. You should also decide on house access rules, pet containment, and dedicated parking space for work vehicles before the first day of demolition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the entire room of belongings, confirm your tile and finish selections in advance, and plan a clear pathway, pet safety, and work crew access into the home.
